label: Qwen-Image-2512 T2I (true-CFG)
prompt: A futuristic cyberpunk city at night, neon lights reflecting on wet streets
negative_prompt: 低分辨率，低画质，肢体畸形，手指畸形，画面过饱和，蜡像感，人脸无细节，过度光滑，画面具有AI感。构图混乱。文字模糊，扭曲。
_note: Qwen-Image quality path = official diffusers true-CFG (true_cfg_scale=4.0 + negative_prompt), two transformer forwards per step. Sibling of the no-CFG qwen_image_2512_t2i_1024 (single forward). Both sglang and vLLM-Omni receive identical true_cfg_scale+negative_prompt via the shared payload, so the two-pass comparison is apples-to-apples. Provenance: sglang notes qwen_image_perf_issue_20260508.md.

blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.description: Blackwell 2-GPU CFG-parallel SGLang-Diffusion Qwen-Image true-CFG profile.
blackwell-2gpu-cfg-parallel.notes: Measured on 4xB200 2026-09-14, two interleaved rounds, against the --tp-size 2 that `default` supplied on Blackwell for want of a hardware profile: 4.862 -> 4.038 and 4.873 -> 3.838, both rounds the same sign, about -19%. The h100/h200 profile already used CFG parallelism for this model; Blackwell simply had no profile and fell back to a TP pin. Note --tp-size N also sets _has_explicit_parallel_policy(), which SUPPRESSES the runtime's own CFG-parallel auto-selection, so the old pin was a decision not to use CFG parallelism. The cfg-parallel arm is bimodal within a run (~3.84 and ~4.04); even its slow mode beats TP by 17%.

h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.description: H100 2-GPU SGLang Qwen-Image true-CFG: CFG parallelism (each GPU runs one CFG branch, no per-layer all-reduce) + resident + compile. Fastest for the 2-branch quality path.
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.sglang_ref: origin/main + PR #29774 (Shard QwenImage DiT across TP ranks; open, not yet merged)
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-eager.notes: CFG parallelism is the cookbook-recommended Qwen multi-GPU path. Measured: 6.49s vs TP #29774 11.07s vs vLLM 10.14s (CFG-parallel 1.56x faster than vLLM). TP shards the DiT but RowParallel all-reduce dominates (~70% kernel time) for the 2-branch case; CFG-parallel avoids it. No #29774 needed here (DiT replicated, one branch per GPU).

blackwell-cudnn.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for qwen_image_2512_t2i_1024_truecfg using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box.

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Same graph with true CFG (KSampler cfg = true_cfg_scale, the case's negative prompt encoded every request). Two GPUs through ComfyUI's only multi-GPU path, the core MultiGPU CFG Split node, which runs the two guidance branches on separate cards -- the counterpart of sglang's CFG parallelism here. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.
